from typing import Optional
import pandas as pd

# Compute percentage of women among clients who own accounts opened in districts with avg salary > 10000.
# Materialization provides table: client_account_district_salary

sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    client_id,
    lower(trim(CAST(gender AS VARCHAR))) AS g
  FROM client_account_district_salary
  WHERE district_avg_salary > 10000
    AND lower(trim(CAST(disp_type AS VARCHAR))) = 'owner'
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS total_clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g LIKE 'f%' THEN client_id END) AS female_clients
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  total_clients,
  female_clients,
  CASE WHEN total_clients > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * CAST(female_clients AS DOUBLE) / CAST(total_clients AS DOUBLE), 2) ELSE NULL END AS pct_female
FROM agg;
